## Contract review

PR objectui#11993, round 10 of card objectui#6152 (draft, base `main`, first line `Part of #6152 (round 10)`, no closing keyword, so the card stays open for round 11). Inputs, and nothing else: the card body and all 67 comments (the round-8 ACCEPT `6060539258` that booked this round and its restatements in `6061003736`, `6063350688` and `6063750702`; the claim `6063790756`; the dev report `6065197618`; the standing rulings `5957903936` and `5958245046`; the earlier at-tier records on this card for shape), the PR body, its 16-file list, the net diff against `main` at the merge base `1473757b` (16 files, +542 / −47, the same 16 paths as the file list, 3 commits), and the 43 check-runs on this head: 40 success, 3 skipped by design (dependabot, coverage, coverage shard), 0 failure. Gate verdicts are read off those check-runs; nothing was built, run or re-run here, and the shared checkout was read with `git show`, `git grep` and `git diff` only. The dev's local vitest counts, type-check sweeps, census, probes and ablations are read as declared, not as verdicts.

### ① Derived judgments

Published TypeScript face (`@object-ui/types`, `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`):

1. `ObjectGridSchema.defaultFilters`: a string-keyed `Record` of `any` to `SpecObjectGridProps['defaultFilters']`, which the new pin reads as `ViewFilterRule[] | undefined` — RIGHT. This is the item the round-8 ACCEPT booked for round 10 (`6060539258`, carried in `6063350688` and `6063750702`): the `object-grid` row has declared the member as the same rule array as `filter` since spec 17.6.0, and the installed spec on this head is 17.7.0 (`packages/types/package.json` declares `^17.7.0`; the lockfile resolves `@objectstack/spec@17.7.0`). Two effects, both intended: the rule array now type-checks where it was a `tsc` error, and the record form `{ status: 'open' }` is a `tsc` error where it type-checked. The `@deprecated` tag stays, matching the row's own "Prefer `filter`" (narrowed, not retired). The member is taken by reference through the existing `SpecObjectGridProps` alias, on the round-8 `filter` precedent.
2. The `object-view` `table` slot moves with it on the TypeScript face — RIGHT and necessary, not a separate stroke: `ObjectViewSchema.table` is a partial pick of `ObjectGridSchema` over `ObjectGridSlotKey`, and `'defaultFilters'` is in that key list (`objectql.ts` about `:2397`), so `table: { defaultFilters: { status: 'open' } }` is refused at compile time and the rule array is accepted. Pinned with a real `@ts-expect-error` directive on the slot literal and an `Equal` type pin on the slot member.
3. `ObjectGanttSchema.filter` and `ObjectMapSchema.filter`: `any[]` to `SpecObjectGanttProps['filter']` / `SpecObjectMapProps['filter']` (each `ViewFilterRule[] | undefined`) — RIGHT, the second half of the same booking. Narrowing only: `any[]` admitted the AST tuple array `[['status', '=', 'open']]`, which the rows refuse. The two new type imports (`ObjectGanttProps as SpecObjectGanttProps`, `ObjectMapProps as SpecObjectMapProps`) follow the file's existing aliasing rule, and the alias is needed because `ObjectGanttProps` is also `plugin-gantt`'s own component props name.
4. No other exported declaration moved. The diff's remaining `objectql.ts` lines are the three members' doc comments, each of which states the objectui#10199 split (the read is wider than the authored face) rather than publishing the runtime AST shape — RIGHT, the shape `ObjectGridSchema.filter` already uses.

Zod accept sets (`@object-ui/types/zod`, `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`: the flat mirrors, the tolerant `AnyComponentSchema`, the strict `StrictAnyComponentSchema`, `safeValidateSchema`):

5. `ObjectGridSchema.defaultFilters`: `z.record(z.string(), z.any()).optional()` to `stripImportedDefaults(SpecObjectGridPropsSchema).shape.defaultFilters` — RIGHT. The mirror WIDENS: the rule array the row declares was refused by the record validator and now parses. It NARROWS: the record is refused at `defaultFilters` with the row's own `ruleArrayFilterError` message, which computes the rule array from the author's keys; the tuple array is refused at `defaultFilters.0`; an unknown operator and a string clause are refused. Identity with the row's member is pinned (`toBe`, with a control that it is not the row's `filter`), and verdict equality with the installed row is pinned over eight values with "both verdicts occur" asserted. The spelling is the round-8 `filter` line's (`:632`), the inline form `check:spec-symbols` requires.
6. The `object-view` `table` slot moves on all three doors — RIGHT and necessary: the slot is built from `ObjectGridSchema.shape` (`:1283`, `BaseSchema.extend(ObjectGridSchema.shape)` then `.omit(...)`, the withheld set and `.partial()`), so `table.defaultFilters` now accepts the rule array and refuses the record at `table.defaultFilters` with the protocol's message, and the tuple array at `table.defaultFilters.0`, on the tolerant face, the strict face and `safeValidateSchema`. This is objectui's own door and the one authored door this round moves, as the booking said. Pinned per door, with `table.filter` as the lit control (unchanged since round 8) and the `object-view` mirror's own slot agreeing.
7. `ObjectGanttSchema.filter` and `ObjectMapSchema.filter`: `z.array(z.any()).optional()` to the rows' own `filter` members — RIGHT. Narrows the flat mirrors only (tuple array, AST node, record, unknown operator refused). No authored door moves: since objectui#10859 the authored `object-gantt` / `object-map` node's `properties` bag IS the row, and the parity ledger's own arm descriptions (`zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` about `:5002` and `:5013`) pair the flat mirror with the TS declaration as "the renderer's post-hoist reading", not with the authored arm. Identity pinned, with a gantt-is-not-map control.
8. The authored `object-grid` node's bag is unchanged and gives the same verdicts — RIGHT, pinned as a control on all three doors.
9. `stripImportedDefaults` leaves the static type and, for a member without a default, the member object itself unchanged (its docblock: the same object every call; `T` in, `T` out), so "by reference" is literal here. The identity pins above are the measurement, green under the Test shards.

Readers (no code moved):

10. `ObjectGrid.tsx` (+8 / −7), `ObjectView.tsx` (+4 / −3) and `core/src/utils/filter-converter.ts` (+6 / −2) change comments only; each hunk was read. The read site is unchanged: `ObjectGrid` hands `{ filter: schema.filter, defaultFilters: schema.defaultFilters }` to `useResolvedGridFilters` and lowers both through the `toFilterNode` sink (`:2040` to `:2050`), so a rule array in the legacy slot already reached the wire as AST (objectui#4082). RIGHT: a declaration gap, not an implementation gap, exactly the case the claim conditioned a reader change on ("only if the spec shape needs a reader change").
11. The new `plugin-grid` pin `ObjectGrid.defaultFiltersRuleArray-6152.test.tsx` measures H2 through the registered renderer and a `ValueDataSource` that applies `$filter`: a `defaultFilters` rule array sends `[['status', 'equals', 'open']]` and draws two of three rows; the same array as `filter` sends the same and draws the same; a `closed` rule moves both readings (lit control); no key draws all three with no `$filter`; `filter` wins when both are written. Fixtures typed `ObjectGridSchema` with no cast. RIGHT.
12. The read did not narrow, and the 18 record-valued cells in 5 untyped runtime tests stay as pins of the read — RIGHT, the objectui#10199 split as round 8 treated its AST-fed runtime fixtures; `gridDefaultFiltersLowering`'s two comments now say the record was the declared shape "until this round", which is true.
13. `ObjectView.tsx` still composes `defaultFilters: viewFilter || authoredFilters.tableDefaults` (`:2517`), where `viewFilter` is a named view's `filter` (`NamedListView.filter`, `any[]`), assignable to the narrowed slot; Type Check is green. No producer in `packages/*/src` or `apps/` writes a record into `defaultFilters`: read off `git grep` at the head, every non-test hit is one of the two read sites above, a comment, or a declaration.

Test fixtures and censuses:

14. Four typed fixtures re-spelled to the rule array — RIGHT, each a `tsc` error under the narrowed member: `ObjectGrid.filterContextTokens-10607` (two cells now use the file's `MINE` rule), `ObjectView.tableSlotRelay-10976` (one cell, deliberately a `lost` rule distinct from `filter`'s `open` so a slot swap cannot read as arrival), `ObjectMap.schemaAlignment` (one cell), `gantt-flat-config-declared-keys` (`GOOD.filter`, and the strict `Equal` pin `_FilterIsDeclared` now reads `ViewFilterRule[] | undefined`; the `@ts-expect-error` on a string `filter` keeps biting).
15. `object-gallery-filter-9309`'s source census: the gantt and map rows now read `SpecObjectGanttProps['filter']` / `SpecObjectMapProps['filter']` — RIGHT; a text census of the declarations, red otherwise.
16. The new types pin `grid-default-filters-gantt-map-filter-round10-6152.test.ts`: a precondition block on the installed protocol (so a spec bump that moves these rows reddens here first), the identity block, the four-member differential, the three-door slot block, and a TypeScript block whose `@ts-expect-error` directives are real (the package type-checks its tests, so a re-widened member fails on the unused directive) — RIGHT. The parity ledgers (`UnmirroredDeclared`, `KnownDrift`, `WiderThanDeclared`, `MirroredUndeclared`) are untouched and green under the Test shards: both faces moved together, so no ledger row was owed.

Docs and prose:

17. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-view.mdx` and `packages/plugin-view/README.md`: the "write this / not this" row taught `defaultFilters` as a record of field to value (equality-only); it now teaches the rule array and states the refusal — RIGHT and required, since the old row is false on this head. These are the only two prose sites naming `defaultFilters` outside tests (read off `git grep` over `content/`, `skills/`, `docs/`, `examples/` and every README at the head), which agrees with the dev's census. Build Docs, Doc Snippet Type Check, Doc Example Id Check, Skill Example Check and Internal Docs Link Check are green.
18. The gantt and map registration `filter` rows (`plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx:182`, `plugin-map/src/index.tsx:119`) already describe the rule-array form and say the record is not this key's shape; nothing was owed there, and nothing on the registration side is false on this head.

File surface against the claim `6063790756`: `objectql.ts` and `objectql.zod.ts` "with their tests" (the two new pins, the 9309 census, the gantt-flat-config pin); `ObjectGrid.tsx` and `filter-converter.ts` (comment repairs the claim conditioned on a sentence becoming false, which it did); the two authored documents the census found; one `.changeset/6152-*.md`. Beyond the literal list: one comment in `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` (a sentence this head makes false; the round-9 ACCEPT `6063350688` amended its surface for the same class), and the typed fixtures in `plugin-grid`, `plugin-view` and `plugin-map` tests that the narrowing turned into `tsc` errors (the round-8 ACCEPT `6060539258` read "with their tests" to cover the consumers' fixtures). Both fences hold: `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` is not in the file list, and the list VIEW's per-view-type blocks (`KanbanConfig`, `CalendarConfig`, `GalleryConfig`, `TimelineConfig`) are outside every `objectql.zod.ts` hunk. Governed Surface Queue Guard is green.

### ② Semver level

- What the diff publishes: on `@object-ui/types`, one TypeScript member widened and narrowed (`ObjectGridSchema.defaultFilters`, and through the slot pick `ObjectViewSchema.table.defaultFilters`), two TypeScript members narrowed (`ObjectGanttSchema.filter`, `ObjectMapSchema.filter`); on the zod side, `table.defaultFilters` widened (rule array) and narrowed (record, tuple array) on the tolerant face, the strict face and `safeValidateSchema`, and the two flat gantt / map mirrors narrowed with no authored door. No renderer behaviour moved. `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-view` carry comment-only source changes; `@object-ui/plugin-map` carries one re-spelled typed test under `src/`.
- `.changeset/6152-grid-default-filters-gantt-map-filter.md`: `@object-ui/types` minor; `core`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-view` patch. Headed `feat(types)!:`, with a "Widened" paragraph (the rule array, the `table` slot on all three faces), a "Narrowed (breaking)" list naming each refusal, its respelling and the better remedy (`filter`), and a "What did not move" paragraph (the renderers' reads; the sink still lowering a runtime record or AST). It names the flat gantt / map members as describing the node as the renderers read it, with the authored bag already refusing the tuple array — MATCHES what the diff publishes. The fixed release group prices a stated break as `minor` (the precedent of every PASSed round on this card; `check-changeset-no-major` stands and Changeset Bump Policy is green), and the four patch entries are the presence gate's reading of the touched released packages (the round-8 shape), with the body saying exactly what each carries. Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Overwrite Report and Changeset Claim Re-read are all success; `git grep` over `.changeset/*.md` at the head finds no other pending body naming `defaultFilters`, `ObjectGanttSchema` or `ObjectMapSchema`, so no append-only note was owed.
- The `Clause-②:` line reads `yes` on the claim, `yes` on the changeset, and `Clause-②: yes — it widens: … It narrows: …` on one line of the PR body — RIGHT: the diff does widen (the rule array parses and type-checks where it was refused), so `yes` is the true value, and the two-way effect is written out on all three sites, the shape the round-6 ACCEPT (`5958245046`) PASSed for a mixed diff. Noted, not flagged: the round-3 amendment (`5914873302`) spelled a widen-and-narrow diff `yes (narrowing)`; either spelling names this diff, no gate reads the arm, and the three sites agree with each other and with the diff.
